title: Chapter 5 — The Allowance Is Late
description: The Foundation's money doesn't come. Garri stops being a snack. Dubai's laptop glows all night, and Tobi offers a loan like it's nothing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The scholarship allowance was due on the first. It is the twentieth. You have ₦600, a bag of garri, and a sachet of sugar you are saving for a special occasion.

beats.speaker: settlement
beats.text: (on the phone) The allowance will come after the Honourable's rally. Everything comes after the rally. Be patient. Be visible.

beats.speaker: dubai
beats.text: (not looking up from his laptop) Roomie. You've drunk garri three times today. That's not a meal, that's a cry for help.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: Rent for the hostel corner, food, transport. You need ₦15,000 by Friday.

options.text: Tutor freshers in GST. You passed it. They didn't.
Sell your lecture notes at the cafeteria.
Borrow from Tobi. He won't even notice.

beats.objective: Find your tutoring group at the library.

perfect.toast: Six freshers pay ₦2,500 each and tell their friends. You have a waiting list.

beats.objective: Set up at the cafeteria with your notes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Night. Dubai's laptop is the only light in the room. He is talking in an American accent to a woman in Ohio called Brenda. He calls her "babe". He has never been to Ohio.

beats.speaker: dubai
beats.text: (muting the call) Watch this. Learn. In twenty minutes Brenda will send six hundred dollars for my "customs fees". That's your allowance for a year.

beats.speaker: dubai
beats.text: He turns the screen towards you.

options.text: Put your earphones in and face the wall.

beats.speaker: dubai
beats.text: (after the call) Brenda sent seven hundred. (He doesn't look happy. He looks like a man who has done arithmetic.)

variants.text: (after the call, very quietly) Brenda is somebody's mother. (He closes the laptop.) So is mine. Mine sells tomatoes at Mile 12. Goodnight, roomie.

beats.title: The Allowance Is Late
beats.summary: Hunger teaches fast. You found ₦15,000 one way or another, and you saw exactly how Dubai finds his.
